verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents natural-language operation through its official Mail MCP server: users can drive the inbox and calendar from Claude or ChatGPT with prompts to summarize, draft, send, schedule and handle follow-ups. In-app, Ask AI answers conversational questions with follow-ups, and plain-language instructions and prompts configure drafting and Auto Labels. Missing for 10: evidence of in-app natural-language commands that perform actions (Ask AI is documented for Q&A, and Cmd+K is a command palette rather than free-form language), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflows work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools. You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar
Connect Claude or ChatGPT directly to your inbox to read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt — no copy-pasting required.
Handle every follow-up with one prompt.
You can also do things that are uniquely Superhuman: triage by Split Inbox, track sent emails, check Read Statuses, Smart Send, and Ask AI.
You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
You can even make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts like "job applications" or "requests to review work".
